title: The Tired traveller at the door
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：tired　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tired 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the craftsman wrote of ① a tired traveller at the door in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② more tired than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the tired ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most tired traveller at the door anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too tired to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the tired ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a tired voice of the teacher, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as tired as the voice of the teacher they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was tired or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something tired, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite tired; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the tired ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, at once, she wrote of another tired traveller at the door in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more tired than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most tired voice of the teacher in the whole workshop, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the tired ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 疲倦（前置定语 a tired traveller at the door：1952 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件疲倦的旅人）
B. adj. 疲倦／厌倦（比较级 more tired than：文中两处，一处比门口疲倦的旅人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 疲倦／厌倦（最高级 the most tired：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 疲倦（表语 too tired to do：母亲觉得它太疲倦，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 厌倦（前置定语 a tired voice of the teacher：叔叔把整件事称作一桩厌倦的声音）
F. adj. 厌倦（同级比较 as tired as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老师疲惫的声音相比）
G. adj. 厌倦（后置定语 something tired：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 厌倦（受程度副词修饰 quite tired：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a tired traveller at the door
the most tired traveller at the door anybody
a tired voice of the teacher
The most tired voice of the teacher in

answers.why: tired 意为“疲倦”，1952 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件疲倦的旅人”，此处作前置定语 a tired traveller at the door。
tired 意为“疲倦”，此处用比较级 more tired than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
tired 意为“疲倦”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说它是工坊里最疲倦的一件，故用最高级 the most tired traveller at the door。
tired 意为“疲倦”，母亲认为这件东西“太疲倦了，谁也用不上”，too tired to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
tired 意为“厌倦”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩厌倦的声音”，此处作前置定语 a tired voice of the teacher。
tired 意为“厌倦”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老师疲惫的声音一样厌倦”，同级比较用 as tired as。
tired 意为“厌倦”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“厌倦的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something tired。
tired 意为“厌倦”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当厌倦”，quite 修饰原级 tired。
tired 意为“厌倦”，1962 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要厌倦”，故用比较级 more tired than。
tired 意为“厌倦”，母亲 1964 年说的是“整个工坊里最厌倦的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most tired voice of the teacher。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件疲倦的旅人。（a tired traveller at the door）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更疲倦。（more tired than …）
母亲觉得它太疲倦，谁也用不上。（too tired to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩厌倦的声音。（a tired voice of the teacher）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老师疲惫的声音一样厌倦。（as tired as …）
到了 1959 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件厌倦的东西。（something tired）
answers: In 1952 the craftsman wrote of a tired traveller at the door in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more tired than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too tired to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a tired voice of the teacher.
He said nobody would call it as tired as the voice of the teacher they had once had.
By 1959 the ledger asked for nothing but something tired.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 tired 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the craftsman wrote of a tired traveller at the door in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most tired traveller at the door in the workshop, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too tired to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a tired voice of the teacher, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite tired, and everybody laughed.
The tired ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
